version.changelog: Constrain activation and recovery scope, treat recovered material as untrusted, surface provenance and conflicts, and gate cross-source actions and persistence.

llm.summary: This skill is a read-only context recovery guide with clear limits, consent gates, and privacy protections.

dimensions.detail: Conversation and history access are proportionate to the context-recovery purpose, and the skill explicitly forbids broad filesystem searching for session or memory data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no executable scripts, bundled code, dependencies, or install-time behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill limits activation to explicit recovery needs or evident compaction, prefers current context first, bounds current-thread retrieval, and requires approval for other sources.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill is read-only by default and forbids persisting recovered content unless the user explicitly consents to the exact redacted content and destination.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is recovering missing conversation context, and the instructions are directly focused on bounded, evidence-based recovery.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill may help the agent inspect recent conversation history when context is missing, but it is designed to keep that access bounded, read-only, and approval-based for external sources.
